Container.Name: TradingAgents
Container.Overview:
TradingAgents v0.7.1 (upstream TauricResearch release).
Image built from the v0.7.1 tag and published to Docker Hub as fradser/tradingagents:v0.7.1-frad and :latest (2026-11-09). Unraid's Update Container works now that the tag is published. Rebuild locally with Home Lab/backups/frad-nas-tradingagents-20261108/build-image.sh.
The container idles on `sleep infinity`; there is no WebUI. Run analyses with docker exec: docker exec -it TradingAgents bash docker exec TradingAgents tradingagents --ticker NVDA --date 2026-11-06 --analysts market,news --save --no-show docker exec TradingAgents tradingagents backtest NVDA,AAPL --start 2026-01-01 --end 2026-06-30
Headless runs need --ticker, --date, --analysts, --save/--no-save and --show/--no-show; provider, models, language and debate rounds come from the TRADINGAGENTS_* variables below. The v0.2.4 flags --provider, --deep-model, --quick-model, --backend-url, --depth, -l and the `analyze` subcommand no longer exist.
Endpoint name: magpie LLM: Magpie gateway at http://10.10.0.195:3425/v1 through the openai provider with a custom backend URL. Every model tier uses hunyuan-eval/hy4-dev. The generic openai_compatible entry suppresses tool_choice and lets managers fall back to free text (REVIEW ratings), so it is not used here. Section reports: /mnt/user/appdata/tradingagents/logs/<TICKER>/<DATE>/reports/. The combined complete_report.md and complete_report.html go to logs/reports/<TICKER>_<STAMP>/. Decision history: memory/trading_memory.md (435 pre-upgrade entries kept). Cache: cache/ (regenerable).
Upgrade 2026-11-08: v0.2.4-frad fork image to upstream v0.7.1, Python 3.13, valid model IDs, unless-stopped restart policy, json-file log rotation, pids limit. Same day: all model tiers moved to the magpie endpoint (Magpie gateway :3425), model hunyuan-eval/hy4-dev, replacing the CLIProxyAPI gpt-6 pair. Rollback images/templates: backups/frad-nas-tradingagents-20261108/.
